verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents account- and project-level access tokens with explicit scopes. For example, a post_client_item-only token can only send events and cannot read data. Tokens can be disabled and replaced at any time, and new tokens are encrypted after creation. That gives a user what they need to issue least-privilege credentials, such as for the documented MCP server an agent runs. A community note criticizes a default never-expiring read token, but that is a default-configuration concern, not a contradiction of scoping. Missing for 10: full documented scope list (read/write/server scopes), token expiry or time-bounded credentials, agent-specific guidance on scoping tokens for the MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration.
